items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: And my boy June, he played, Marshall Lawrence, he played saxophone.

ctx.x: Well, Leroy played, Arsenault played trumpet.
And Leroy played the tenor sax. And my boy June, he played, Marshall Lawrence, he played saxophone. And this French boy, I forget it. What relation is he to Morris? His brother. That's his brother.
He played trumpet. So there's several of them that play music in it. Oh yeah, there were four of them.
